caption: The drawing depicts a tall, narrow wooden cupboard with a reddish-brown finish. The cupboard is rectangular in shape and stands vertically with a flat top and base. The front face features two paneled doors, one above the other, each with beveled edges. The upper door has a round wooden knob on the left and a hinge on the right, while the lower door also has hinges on the right and a square brass latch on the left. The cupboard is set against a plain, light beige background. At the bottom center of the image, the words "Narrow Cupboard" are written in a simple, light gray handwritten style.
title: Shaker Tall Tin Cupboard
